jemcompat.patchouli.name: JEM Engineering Notes
jemcompat.patchouli.landing_text: A short field guide to the mechanical drill lifecycle.
jemcompat.patchouli.engineering.name: Technologia!
jemcompat.patchouli.engineering.descript: Build, service, and replace mechanical drills.
jemcompat.patchouli.drill_work.name: Put It to Work
jemcompat.patchouli.drill_work.text: A mechanical drill only wears while it is doing real work on a moving contraption. Natural stone is the first sign that the machine has started its service life.
jemcompat.patchouli.drill_service.name: Service Interval
jemcompat.patchouli.drill_service.text: Stop the machine before servicing a worn drill. An iron ingot restores one repairable drill, and the machine must be still while you work on it.
jemcompat.patchouli.drill_replaced.name: New Drill, Same Job
jemcompat.patchouli.drill_replaced.text: A drill that has used its repair allowance can still finish its work, but it cannot be repaired again. Replace the worn-out drill in the stopped contraption and get the machine moving again.
message.jemcompat.backtobed.used_today: You have already used the Magical Returner today.
tooltip.jemcompat.spearhead_pennant: A decorative pennant used in Fairy Lights garlands.
tooltip.jemcompat.moretotems.explosive_t: Prevents death and creates an explosion around its holder.
tooltip.jemcompat.moretotems.ghastly_tot: Prevents death; grants Levitation, Slow Falling, and Fire Resistance.
tooltip.jemcompat.moretotems.rotting_tot: Prevents death; summons 3 allied zombies and grants Necrosis.
tooltip.jemcompat.moretotems.skeletal_to: Prevents death; Sniper doubles projectile damage.
tooltip.jemcompat.moretotems.stinging_to: Prevents death and summons 5 bees that defend the holder.
tooltip.jemcompat.moretotems.teleporting: Prevents death and returns the holder to their spawn point.
tooltip.jemcompat.moretotems.tentacled_t: Prevents death; Cephalopod blinds and slows enemies.
tooltip.jemcompat.transport.elytra: Glides from height; rockets provide acceleration and lift.
tooltip.jemcompat.transport.paraglider: Slows falling and allows gliding while consuming stamina.
tooltip.jemcompat.transport.happy_ghast: Flying transport for up to four players; a harness is required for control.
tooltip.jemcompat.transport.harness: Equips a Happy Ghast and allows players to control it in flight.
tooltip.jemcompat.transport.laviathan: Carries up to four players across the Nether's lava seas.
tooltip.jemcompat.transport.spectre: After being lured with a Soul Heart, lets a player hitch a flying ride with a lead.
tooltip.jemcompat.transport.straddler: A lava-region mount that requires a Straddlite Saddle.
tooltip.jemcompat.transport.elephant: A large land mount tamed with Acacia Blossoms.
tooltip.jemcompat.transport.tusklin: A fast and powerful mount for travelling through the Nether.
tooltip.jemcompat.transport.subterranodo: A flying mount with separate ascend and descend controls.
tooltip.jemcompat.transport.atlatitan: A huge land mount whose special stomp can level nearby terrain.
tooltip.jemcompat.transport.tremorsaurus: A combat land mount with a controllable roar.
tooltip.jemcompat.transport.mount: Spawns a rideable creature; taming or equipment requirements depend on the species.
tooltip.jemcompat.transport.item: An item used for controlled travel through the world.
